response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing') AS powerstatus_grp, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing')), shares AS (SELECT powerstatus_grp, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_above_by_share FROM above;
